interventions.what: Bandicam window capture of the Isle Wars Pro game window; the owner played one game from the options screen to the end screen (18:23 recording). The video file is the only output. No scripted clicks. Counters, seats and screens were read from pixels by region comparison and template matching of glyph shapes, with no OCR pass.

start_state.restore: Owner launched a new game on the unregistered Pro build from the options screen (seat 1 human, three computer seats, middle strength). Pro has no save file (C-SET-05), so no state was restored. The recording starts on the title screen; the opening deal is the first board.

observations.field: move summary
observations.value: six human moves in 13 human turns (turns 3, 27, 31, 35, 38, 44), each after at least one capture of the turn and after the last attack, one per turn; every move left exactly 1 army in the source (6 of 6: sources of 3, 2, 8, 2, 8 and 6 armies, moves of 2, 1, 7, 1, 7 and 5); all but one was reached with the all button three times (moves 3, 5, 6), with the plus button once (move 1, from 1 to 2), and by leaving the counter at 1 on a source of 2 twice (moves 2, 4); all-but-two, a counter of 0 and sources of 5 or 10 were not tried; no second move in a turn was offered (the turn ended after done)

observations.field: move controls: the sequence on screen (move 1, 00:59.0 to 01:10.8)
observations.value: the action bar (attack, move, pass, card and cancel buttons) at 00:59.0; the move button starts a move; the left panel then asks for the country to move from, with an arrow marker, and the middle panel shows only a cancel button at 01:04.5; clicking a country of the owner shows the source country named in the right panel at 01:05.2 and the left panel asks for the destination; clicking a neighbour shows the destination named and the move counter panel (a counter starting at 1, an all button, a plus button, a minus button and a done button) at 01:06.4; the counter changes with the all button (all but one), the plus and minus buttons (one at a time); the done button, green when the pointer is over it (01:10.5), commits the move; no confirmation question follows. A button under the pointer shows a gold fill (all, plus, minus) or a green fill (done); the buttons are grey otherwise.

observations.field: move controls: positions
